title: The Compass of Valparaíso
author: Bram Whitlock
blurb: Kestrel Winterbourne, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
